message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "3-9 FEBRUARI 2014." The central figure is a man with a wide, sweating face, bared teeth, and large eyes. He wears a bright orange short-sleeved jumpsuit with a vertical white stripe on the right side of the chest and a black waist bag.

The man stands centrally against a white background. His hands emerge from his pockets holding a black fuel hose that passes through both pockets. The right side of the hose terminates in a blue fuel nozzle held in his left hand, which drips a single dark droplet.

The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red capital letters at the top. Above it, black text reads "SIAPA BUNUH PENGHUNI KEBUN BINATANG SURABAYA". To the right of the man, large black text says "NGERI-NGERI SUAP" followed by "Sutan Bhatoegana dituduh menerima dan membagikan uang rasuah SKK Migas." The bottom left corner contains a price "RP 33.000", a website URL, and a barcode. A thick red vertical bar borders the left edge.
